programs.name: Abstract in a Day
programs.description:
Spend a day experimenting,
playing and creating in this hands-on abstract painting intensive. Designed
for busy creatives, explore palette knives, brushes, taping, pouring, collage and other techniques while drawing inspiration from historical and contemporary
abstraction. Create a series of experimental pieces throughout the day before
bringing your favourite techniques together in one bold, completely unique
final artwork. No experience necessary—just
come ready to experiment and make something your own!

Designed  for busy creatives, explore palette knives, brushes, taping, pouring, collage and other techniques while drawing inspiration from historical and contemporary  abstraction. Create a series of experimental pieces throughout the day before  bringing your favourite techniques together in one bold, completely unique  final artwork. No experience necessary—just  come ready to experiment and make something your own!

This course is also offered as a four-week intensive.

programs.name: Abstract in a Day
programs.description:
Spend a day experimenting,
playing and creating in this hands-on abstract painting intensive. Designed
for busy creatives, explore palette knives, brushes, taping, pouring, collage and other techniques while drawing inspiration from historical and contemporary
abstraction. Create a series of experimental pieces throughout the day before
bringing your favourite techniques together in one bold, completely unique
final artwork. No experience necessary—just
come ready to experiment and make something your own!

programs.name: Abstract in a Day
programs.description:
Spend a day experimenting,
playing and creating in this hands-on abstract painting intensive. Designed
for busy creatives, explore palette knives, brushes, taping, pouring, collage and other techniques while drawing inspiration from historical and contemporary
abstraction. Create a series of experimental pieces throughout the day before
bringing your favourite techniques together in one bold, completely unique
final artwork. No experience necessary—just
come ready to experiment and make something your own!

Designed  for busy creatives, explore palette knives, brushes, taping, pouring, collage and other techniques while drawing inspiration from historical and contemporary  abstraction. Create a series of experimental pieces throughout the day before  bringing your favourite techniques together in one bold, completely unique  final artwork. No experience necessary—just  come ready to experiment and make something your own!

This course is also offered as a four-week intensive.

programs.name: Abstract in a Day
programs.description:
Spend a day experimenting,
playing and creating in this hands-on abstract painting intensive. Designed
for busy creatives, explore palette knives, brushes, taping, pouring, collage and other techniques while drawing inspiration from historical and contemporary
abstraction. Create a series of experimental pieces throughout the day before
bringing your favourite techniques together in one bold, completely unique
final artwork. No experience necessary—just
come ready to experiment and make something your own!

playing and creating in this hands-on abstract painting intensive. Designed
for busy creatives, explore palette knives, brushes, taping, pouring, collage and other techniques while drawing inspiration from historical and contemporary

bringing your favourite techniques together in one bold, completely unique
final artwork. No experience necessary—just
come ready to experiment and make something your own!

programs.description:
Spend a day experimenting,
playing and creating in this hands-on abstract painting intensive. Designed
for busy creatives, explore palette knives, brushes, taping, pouring, collage and other techniques while drawing inspiration from historical and contemporary
abstraction. Create a series of experimental pieces throughout the day before
bringing your favourite techniques together in one bold, completely unique
final artwork. No experience necessary—just
come ready to experiment and make something your own!

programs.name: Abstract in a Day
programs.description:
Spend a day experimenting,
playing and creating in this hands-on abstract painting intensive. Designed
for busy creatives, explore palette knives, brushes, taping, pouring, collage and other techniques while drawing inspiration from historical and contemporary
abstraction. Create a series of experimental pieces throughout the day before
bringing your favourite techniques together in one bold, completely unique
final artwork. No experience necessary—just
come ready to experiment and make something your own!
